structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of about 17 copies of the same meme (at least 15 on Solana, 2 on BSC) that all launched between about 06:02 and 06:25 UTC on 2026-09-23. They share the name 错版审美吉蛙 (roughly "misprinted Gigi Frog") and the ticker 甲亢蛙 (roughly "hyperthyroid frog"). The story is that the official Taobao store for the viral Chinese art character 审美吉蛙 / Gigi Frog shipped a defective plush, and the store supposedly called it 甲亢蛙. The claimed source post is on Douyin (China's TikTok) and reportedly has 240k likes. This token (EUhED...) launched on the Meteora virtual curve and moved to its main market at the same second. In about 35 minutes it traded roughly $4.1M, rose 400–460%, and had 2,225 unique buyers against only 219 unique sellers. The only link to X is a post from @BSCSBTI, a 41-follower account named for BSC. It was posted at 05:42 UTC, calls this a "top misprint narrative, the next 哭哭马 (crying horse)", and had 1.3k views. At detection the price was already falling 9–22% over 5 minutes.

narrative.description: This is a 'misprint' spin-off of the real and widely covered 审美吉蛙 / Gigi Frog art character. Gigi Frog is by China Academy of Art graduate Zhou Zixin, went viral in June 2026, and has an official Taobao store. The template is 哭哭马 / Misprinted Horse, a plush horse sewn with an upside-down mouth that made Chinese national news in January 2026 and got a BNB-chain token. The specific new event (a defective plush the store called 甲亢蛙, with 240k likes on Douyin) comes only from the promoter's tweet. I could not verify it independently; the Douyin link would not load and web search found nothing.
narrative.why_spreading: The parent character is real and popular in China. Traders on Chinese-speaking crypto X know the misprint-plush template from 哭哭马, which makes this an easy pitch. The spread I can see is a small promoter account and a burst of copycat launches. I saw no organic news coverage or broad social discussion of the 'hyperthyroid frog' incident itself.

token_connection.why_this_token: On Solana it leads its copies by a wide margin in volume ($4.1M) and liquidity ($47k). The runner-up is ENCK19 with $1.2M volume and a $33k market cap. Leading on volume is the only reason to treat it as the main Solana version. It was not the first launch, and nothing ties it to the promoter's tweet or an official source. The tweet and Douyin links in the packet were likely just copied into the token metadata.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 15 Solana tokens with the same name and ticker. The earliest is 46oYbF on pump.fun (06:04 UTC); others include 6LUk3h ($736k volume), HcpCmu ($584k), ENCK19 ($1.2M) and FYveav. There are also 2 BSC tokens; 0xe4db (06:02 UTC, $309k volume) came before every Solana one. The promoter's account (BSCSBTI) is BSC-focused, so BSC may be the intended home chain.

authenticity.evidence: Against it being organic: GMGN flags 173 bundler wallets. The token launched and moved to its main market in the same second, which suggests a bundled, sniped launch. The only visible X promotion is a 41-follower BSC shill account with 1.3k views. There were more than 15 copycat launches within minutes. The Douyin claim cannot be verified. For it: 2,225 unique buyers and about 24k transactions in an hour. GMGN shows a bot/degen rate of 0.35%, a top-10 holder share of 8.8%, no paid DexScreener promotion, and a developer holding 0%.
authenticity.uncertainty: I couldn't read the Douyin note or X search results, so I can't confirm whether the 240k-like viral post exists. Private Chinese Telegram and WeChat groups, where this kind of trading is likely coordinated, are invisible to me.

structural_risks: High turnover (about 85x per hour) on only $47k of liquidity. RugCheck flags a large share of the liquidity-pool tokens as unlocked, while GMGN reports them 100% burned, so the data conflict.
GeckoTerminal puts the top 10 holders at 95% (this probably includes pool accounts); GMGN puts it at 8.8%
173 bundler wallets; the token was created and moved to its main market in the same second
More than 15 same-name copies split the buying, and a BSC copy may be the one people actually mean
Momentum was already reversing at detection (-9% to -22% over 5 minutes, after a peak about 30% above the current price)

structured_output.counterargument: 哭哭马 shows that a misprinted Chinese plush can become a national news story with a lasting token. Gigi Frog is a real IP with a large following. If the Douyin post really has 240k likes and keeps growing, Chinese-speaking crypto traders could pile into the Solana token with the most volume, which is this one. The 10-to-1 ratio of unique buyers to sellers suggests real retail demand, not just wash trading.
unknowns: Whether the Douyin note exists and how many likes it really has
Whether the official Gigi Frog store actually used the name 甲亢蛙
Which chain Chinese-speaking crypto X treats as the real one (BSC or Solana)
What private Telegram/WeChat call groups are doing
Whether the liquidity-pool tokens are really unlocked

source_coverage.notes: I read the X post through the fxtwitter mirror; X itself returned an error (HTTP 402). Searching for the contract address found nothing. News covers the parent Gigi Frog IP (June 2026) and the 哭哭马 precedent, but not the 甲亢蛙 incident. The Douyin note would not render. I used a DexScreener search to map the copycat tokens.

structured_output.thesis: The parent character is real and the misprint template has worked before, but the specific trigger event can't be verified and was pushed by a tiny BSC shill account. This token is one of more than 15 copies on Solana, trails a BSC version in launch time, was launched with heavy bundling, and was already fading at detection. Attention will most likely fade or split across the copies over the next hours unless the Douyin story independently breaks into mainstream Chinese media.
